Layout Categories

Every venue type, fully supported

From auditoriums to aircraft, UV Netware adapts to any space with precision-engineered seating layouts.

Theatre

Tiered row layouts with aisle mapping, balcony zones, and premium section designation.

Restaurant

Flexible table arrangements with covers per table, waitstaff zones, and outdoor patios.

Bus

Row-by-row seat allocation with aisle, window preference filters, and real-time booking.

Train

Coach and cabin configurations, berth layouts, and multi-class compartment management.

Stadium

Circular and bowl-shaped layouts with section blocks, VIP boxes, and entrance mapping.

Conference

Boardroom and classroom formats with presenter zones, delegate assignments, and AV placement.

Theatre Layouts

Precision-Engineered Auditorium Seating

Create tiered row layouts with intelligent aisle mapping and balcony zones. Every seat is accounted for — from front-row VIP to the last row in the upper gallery.

  • Curved & straight row configurations
  • Balcony & mezzanine zone support
  • Premium section designation
  • ADA-compliant accessibility slots
Aviation Seating Layouts

Aircraft Cabin Configurations

Design seating layouts for narrow-body, wide-body, and regional aircraft. From economy rows to premium cabins, every seat finds its perfect place.

  • Economy, premium economy, business, and first-class zones
  • Exit row and bulkhead seat designation
  • Real-time seat availability tracking

About The Project

What Is SmartSeat?

Designing seat layouts shouldn't require CAD software. SmartSeat lets you pick a venue type — theatre, stadium, bus, train, anything — drop your seats, configure zones, and preview the result in real time. It works for a 200-seat auditorium just as well as a 60,000-seat arena.

Built With Modern Tech

What Powers SmartSeat

React + TypeScript on the frontend. Supabase for auth, database, and real-time sync. Firebase for hosting.
